+---

+title: Use the shared pending-work text of FoundationModelsExtras; delete AgentsToolText.injectionSentences
+---
+## Reason
+
+The pending-work text ("This is not the result. When the work finishes, the session injects its result ...") is in more than one package. Agents has a copy in `AgentsToolText.injectionSentences`. Multitool has a copy in `PendingWorkInstruction.text`. Extras has a third, old text in `PendingRunEnvelope.defaultCollectInstruction(forCompletionToken:)` that still tells the model to call a wait tool. Copies that must stay the same are not permitted. The user decided: FoundationModelsExtras owns the one text.
+
+## Dependency
+
+This task waits for the Extras session (`foundationmodelsextras-f0`) to push to `main` the new public constant `PendingRunEnvelope.pendingWorkInstruction`. Do not start before that push. Then run `swift package update FoundationModelsExtras` (or resolve the Router dependency again) so this package gets the new Extras.
+
+## Work
+
+1. Delete `AgentsToolText.injectionSentences`.
+2. `AgentsTool.collectInstruction(forCompletionToken:)`: keep the sentence that names the run, then add `PendingRunEnvelope.pendingWorkInstruction`. If `AgentsToolText` keeps the "This is not the result." prefix, remove it there, because the Extras constant holds the full text.
+3. `AgentsToolDescription.fixedSentences`: use `PendingRunEnvelope.pendingWorkInstruction`.
+4. Tests: delete the copy of the text in `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/Support/PinnedInjectionText.swift`. The tests compare against `PendingRunEnvelope.pendingWorkInstruction`, not against a second copy of the text.
+5. Search Sources, Tests, IntegrationTests and the DocC catalog for other copies of the text, and remove them.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+
+- [ ] The pending-work text is not written in this package. All uses read `PendingRunEnvelope.pendingWorkInstruction` from Extras.
+- [ ] `AgentsToolText.injectionSentences` and the text copy in `PinnedInjectionText.swift` are deleted.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
\ No newline at end of file
